trickyParts: The combined cap's grant rule: a head that fits its class but not the total blocks later arrivals of the other class, so a weight-2 write is not starved by weight-1 reads
A root set up under the old port base keeps its recorded ports; setup refuses them and names the variables to set
deviations: At 10x the head serves fewer reads (about 52/s against 85/s) and commits twice the events: writes hold up to 24 of the 40 units. Named in the PR body's Not proven / risk

The one 1x burst behind a 5.0 s write transaction holding the event horizon (tester round 8, t8-head-1x-a) is INFRA-636's #2468 to remove; named in Not proven / risk, to be re-measured in the tree's final proof once #2468 lands
